jobs.prompt: Make the orchestrator-mode guard release SMALL and remove the swarm worker exemption entirely. Background (owner decision, verified): real swarm workers never load the project's hooks (the Claude CLI worker runs with the safe-mode flag, the shell-mode Claude worker too, Cursor, Codex, Hermes and the API lanes are not Claude Code), so nothing needs exempting from the guard, and the old exemption (a session whose working folder is inside the swarm workspaces or worktrees folder with the environment variable SWARM_WORKER_RUN_ID equal to the run id and a run record present) is a fakeable loophole. Tasks: (1) In tools/shell-writes.mjs delete isVerifiedSwarmWorkerCwd, orchestratorWorkerSessionExempt, runIdFromWorkerCwd, runRecordExists, the SWARM_WORKER_RUN_ID_ENV export and every use of them; remove every exemption branch in tools/handbuild.mjs and tools/orchestrator-allow.mjs (search for exempt, verified, worker session, SWARM_WORKER, worker-token, verifyWorkerToken). After this NO session is ever exempt: the orchestrator-mode rules apply to every session in a swarm project, including one whose working folder is inside a workspace, and setting SWARM_WORKER_RUN_ID or SWARM_WORKER_TOKEN changes nothing. Do not import or mention tools/worker-token.mjs anywhere (it is not part of this release and does not exist on this branch). (2) Update the tests: every test that asserted the exemption (a verified worker may write its workspace, 'R4-11 worker exemption requires verified cwd not env alone', 'a swarm workspace may be written, the checkout from inside it may not', the token based cases in tests/orchestrator-allow.test.mjs, tests/orchestrator-mode.test.mjs, tests/orchestrator-mode-default.test.mjs, tests/orchestrator-mode-review2.test.mjs, tests/orchestrator-mode-review3.test.mjs, tests/orchestrator-mode-review4.test.mjs, tests/handbuild-guard.test.mjs) now asserts there is NO exemption (the same write or command gets the orchestrator decision, and the environment variables change nothing); delete tests that only tested token mechanics. Keep every other assertion. (3) REQUIRED NEW TESTS in tests/orchestrator-allow.test.mjs, through the full guard (the same entry the pre-tool hook uses) with the hand-build guard both on and off, using a temp swarm project root as CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and as the session working folder, exactly like the parts orchestrator session: these must be ALLOWED: swarm tickets T-0001 --set ready --note "a note" --yes; swarm change "reason" docs/scope/scope.md --yes; swarm go --scope --max-jobs 2; swarm go --scope --max-jobs 2 --skip-skeleton; swarm tickets T-0001 --retry-note ok; swarm backlog add "goal"; swarm integrate RUN --queue --no-commit; swarm resume RUN; swarm inbox --json; swarm resolve is DENIED (owner approval) and swarm scope approve --yes is DENIED. Also the earlier bug-report commands stay allowed (gh pr view 12, gh run view 5, grep -rn foo src, cat README.md, git status, git log --oneline -5, npx playwright test, npx vitest run, npm test with a package script, node --test, pytest). (4) The allow-list for writes, the claude-program-only matching, the nested-project-root denial and the shell-write coverage that are already in these files stay exactly as they are. Make tests/orchestrator-allow.test.mjs, tests/orchestrator-mode*.test.mjs, tests/shell-writes*.test.mjs, tests/auto-approve.test.mjs, tests/handbuild*.test.mjs and tests/self-approval-hardening.test.mjs pass. STANDING TEST RULE: every test that spawns a process must set a per-test timeout of 60000 ms or less, pass a timeout to spawnSync, and kill children in its after hook. IMPORTANT: secret scanner: never write literal values for fields named token, secret, key or password in tests.
